correctness.rationale: For w=b^i a^3 b^j a b^k each Abelian square uses 0,2,or4 a symbols. Zero-a factors are b^(2h) up to floor(max(i,j,k)/2). With two a symbols only aa and the last triple a plus singleton yield ab^j ab^y with 0<=y<=min(j,k) and y≡j mod 2, with exactly the j=0 duplicate. Four-a squares must contain all markers and midpoint between the second and third a, hence b^(j+y)a^3 b^j ab^y, j+y<=i. These disjoint content families give theta formula including degeneracies. Universal case split proves 4theta>=i+j+k+3 and modular n=4q+r witnesses attain floor((n+2)/4) for n>=5, with n=4 separate theta=2. Finite direct enumerations of literal factors support but do not establish all n.
